33/G.goal: Summarize the Majuli case study by explaining its heritage-preservation problem, the suitability of VR for digital heritage preservation, and the goals of the proposed VR system.
33/G.achieves: Equips the learner to understand the course’s running XR case study and follow the later stages of developing and implementing an XR system around a real heritage-preservation scenario.

33/O1.goal: Introduce the Majuli case study and explain why the island’s tangible, intangible, and ecological heritage requires preservation because of river erosion.
33/O1.achieves: Gives the learner the problem context for the course’s XR case study, so later requirement, design, and implementation work can be understood as responses to a real heritage-preservation need.

33/O2.goal: Explain why digital immersive preservation with virtual reality is useful for Majuli and describe the goals of the Majuli VR system.
33/O2.achieves: Lets the learner frame the Majuli project as an XR system intended to create a multimedia heritage archive and provide an immersive virtual tour, preparing them for the subsequent system-development lectures.
